scope: All25 source records rechecked via public API; all23 unique existing source image files visually inspected. Manufacturer/category candidates researched; not an exhaustive claim that no 3D file exists anywhere.

sources.finding: 076561: white Mosaic RJ45 Cat6 UTP, one module; not proof of TehNet stock identity.
076561/564 UTP; 076562/565 FTP; 076563/566 STP. Page2 contact gold thickness >0.8 micrometre is a lower bound, not an exact value. No complete internal manufacturing CAD obtained.
Connection/installation sequence; not a licensed fully separated internal 3D assembly.
078731: white two-module RJ11 four contacts; source photo is consistent with that label, not Cat6 RJ45.
078730: white one-module RJ11 four contacts. Similar category only; number not legible on catalogue photo.
051710: Cat6 UTP crimp plug; manufacturer identity of the source100-pack remains unknown.
051711: Cat6 FTP crimp plug; cannot assign to an unbranded source connector by appearance.
Manufacturer VDE certificate distinguishes077210 white screw/no shutter,077211 white screwless/shutter,077218 red screwless/shutter.
077214 red coded/tamperproof is distinct from077218. Colour alone cannot reconcile the retailer codes.
Current French032754 page says U/UTP305m Dca, LSOH; cannot use it as proof of source PVC305 cable. Revision/region matters.
N100.617-DE: U/UTP Cat6 PVC grey305m. Candidate category comparison, not an identified TehNet model.
10518302: another U/UTP Cat6 PVC305m reference; same broad description does not identify one factory article.
N100.624-OD is F1/UTP LSZH orange500m Indoor. OD suffix must not be interpreted as Outdoor; not a match for S/FTP.
Manufacturer Mosaic family; broad family/object dimensions are not exact internal geometry for each catalogue SKU. No file imported.
Actual official RVT link located. Binary not downloaded/parsed; node inventory, exact member coverage and exploded internal geometry unverified.

BIM Geometry Details says functional simplified geometry may omit fixings/details. Respect of rights section requires prior written approval to upload BIM content to another website/server. No such approval for this file is recorded.
Platform terms inspected; no account created, authenticated model download, or TehNet redistribution grant obtained.
